title.zh: 将巴丹省巴兰加市镇波多里瓦斯村Puerto Rivas小学的名称变更为Maximino De Los Reyes纪念学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Puerto Rivas Elementary School in the Barrio of Puerto Rivas, Municipality of Balanga, Province of Bataan, to Maximino De Los Reyes Memorial School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Puerto Rivas Elementary School in the Barrio of Puerto Rivas, Municipality of Balanga, Province of Bataan, to Maximino De Los Reyes Memorial School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Puerto Rivas tại Barrio Puerto Rivas, Thị trấn Balanga, Tỉnh Bataan thành Maximino De Los Reyes Memorial School
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Puerto Rivas ในบารริโอ Puerto Rivas, เทศบาล Balanga, จังหวัด Bataan เป็น Maximino De Los Reyes Memorial School
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Puerto Rivas di Barrio Puerto Rivas, Kotamadya Balanga, Provinsi Bataan menjadi Maximino De Los Reyes Memorial School
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Puerto Rivas di Barrio Puerto Rivas, Perbandaran Balanga, Wilayah Bataan menjadi Maximino De Los Reyes Memorial School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1641_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Puerto Rivas Elementary School in the barrio of Puerto Rivas, Municipality of Balanga, Province of Bataan, is hereby changed to Maximino de los Reyes Memorial School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 20, 1957.
